snippet.title: Stationbreak - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Stationbreak is a grounded sci-fi station builder where you hold failing systems together while fleeing a relentless, energy-hungry force known as the Swarm. Leading a fleet on the run, you must drop into hostile star systems, gather what resources you can, and jump away before you are overwhelmed.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4183580/Stationbreak/

About the Game
Stationbreak is a station-building roguelite driven by creeping dread. You lead a small fleet of capital ships, jumping from one hazardous star system to the next in a desperate bid to survive.

In each system, you construct a temporary space station using whatever resources are available. These stations are built to generate the energy needed for your next jump. Stay longer to optimise your setup, expand your station, and gather more resources. However, the longer you remain, the more dangerous things become as the Swarm closes in.

Every decision is a trade-off. Balance energy, heat, materials, and crew stability while managing a fragile network of systems under constant pressure. Invest in defences to hold back the Swarm, or prioritise escape. You cannot do both forever. The Swarm cannot be defeated, only delayed.

Across procedurally generated systems, each run presents new challenges and constraints. Progress carries between jumps, allowing you to upgrade your fleet, unlock new technologies, and adapt your strategy over time.

Your goal is simple: gather enough energy, survive the escalating threat, and know when to abandon everything and run.
